answer: An AI-agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with a stake-backed identity anchor: each agent locks a refundable bond before it may vote or earn. Identity is tied to one anchor, so a newcomer in the nebula of anonymous accounts cannot multiply itself across a canyon of fake wallets without reposting the full bond for every extra one. Each forged identity thus costs the attacker the entire locked stake, which is slashed on detected fraud, making a large Sybil army prohibitively expensive.
